newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber unchanged in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber unchanged in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were unchanged in late trading on Thursday despite a lack of demand, traders said.
"Trading is very slow because buyers are holding back and waiting for cheaper prices," said one trader. "I think traders are willing to sell at 47.25 if buyers come again to the market," he added.
Traders said offer prices were quoted at 47.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang for August shipment and at 47.125 fob Surabaya for July shipment.
Offer prices were quoted at 47.50 for July/August shipment fob Medan, 47.00 fob Padang and 46.75 fob Pontianak and Jambi, they said.

Traders said supply of raw material had improved in a number of centres, including Medan, because people had started to tap rubber again. Tapping activities have been disturbed by afternoon rains, which affect the quality of the latex.
